name: Clarithromycin
executiveSummary: Macrolide. Adult PO 250–500 mg every 12 h; pediatrics 15 mg/kg/day every 12 h (usual max 1 g/day). IV 500 mg every 12 h when oral route unavailable.
indications:
## Indications

- Upper and lower respiratory tract infections, otitis media, sinusitis due to susceptible organisms (including atypicals: *Mycoplasma*, *Chlamydia*).
- Susceptible skin/soft-tissue infections.
- *Mycobacterium avium* prophylaxis/treatment (specific regimens, higher doses).

## Precautions

- Contraindicated with terfenadine/cisapride (arrhythmia). Interactions: carbamazepine, rifabutin, statins, warfarin.
- Adjust in severe renal impairment.
- IV irritant (phlebitis): no bolus; infuse ≥ 60 min.

> Prefer PO if tolerated. Confirm local susceptibility.

adulto.presentation: Tablets 250–500 mg; suspension; IV vial 500 mg.
adulto.dose: PO usual infections: **250–500 mg every 12 h** (5–14 days by focus). IV: **500 mg every 12 h** (switch to PO ASAP). MAC / antimycobacterial (specialist): up to **500 mg every 12 h** or per institutional regimen.
adulto.administration: PO with or without food. IV: reconstitute 500 mg with 10 mL sterile water (not NS for initial reconstitution); dilute in 250 mL NS or 5% dextrose (~2 mg/mL) and infuse over 60 min.
adulto.notes: Use sterile water only for lyophilizate reconstitution. No IV push.

pediatrico.presentation: Tablets 250 mg; suspension 25 mg/mL; vial 500 mg.
pediatrico.dose: **15 mg/kg/day PO/IV divided every 12 h**. Usual max for common infections: **1 g/day**. Antimycobacterial/MAC-type: up to **30 mg/kg/day** every 12 h (max **1 g/day**) under ID.
pediatrico.administration: PO; IV as in adult (dose-proportional). Do not refrigerate reconstituted suspension (per many labels).
pediatrico.notes: Dose by weight. Verify syrup strength (mg/mL) before measuring.

neonatal.dose: Not routine in neonates; only under ID/neonatology with explicit protocol.
neonatal.notes: Limited data; weigh risk/benefit and interactions.

stability:
## Stability

- Reconstituted (IV vial): ~24 h room temp / ~48 h refrigerated (check label).
- Diluted for infusion: ~6 h room temp / ~48 h refrigerated.
- PO suspension: per manufacturer beyond-use date.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Diarrhea, nausea, abnormal/metallic taste, dyspepsia, abdominal pain, headache, hypersensitivity. QT prolongation/arrhythmia with interacting drugs.
